{{Top|leg}}
'''Flash shields''' were used to compensate for fluctuating light levels. Along with a long-range [[viewplate]], flash shields were installed on high-end [[Snooper Goggles]] to help users compensate for changing light levels. [[Evann]], a commenter on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]], recommended this to potential buyers after almost being blinded while firing a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
